subject: [RFC PATCH 33/57] mm/collapse: split collapse into a scan and a run

2026-08-16.patch_summary: This patch splits the collapse functionality into two separate functions: collapse_scan_pmd() and collapse_run_pmd(). The scan function checks if a table needs to be collapsed, while the run function performs the actual collapse operation. This change improves lock management and reduces unnecessary lock acquisitions, making the code more efficient and easier to understand.
